hash-sync.why: main.tsx passes `initialId={location.hash.slice(1)}` and onActivate calls `history.replaceState(null, '', `#${id}`)`, not pushState.

tab-event.why: onActivate calls `window.jQuery?.(document).trigger('account:tab', [id])` with the panel id, and jQuery is still loaded before the bundle.

billing-dom.why: Tabs.tsx memoizes the `{__html}` objects so React never rewrites panel innerHTML on re-render, and the summary explains billing.js's `.load` is not overwritten.

help-widget.why: help-widget.js now reads `aria-controls` from the selected `[role=tab]`, returning the same ids, and the summary flags the change and the third-party ownership question.

a11y.why: Tabs.tsx implements role tablist/tab/tabpanel, aria-selected, aria-controls, roving tabIndex and Arrow/Home/End key handling.

no-silent-changes.why: The summary calls out the help-widget edit, the markup change from ul/li/a to buttons with the CSS impact, the removal of jQuery UI, the manual deletion of tabs.js, and that the event does not fire on the initial tab.
